purpose: Frozen C5 normal-rendering development recipe; neither appearance acceptance nor publication approval.

comparisonOnly.purpose: Asset-centered source/GLB transport comparison, NOT normal hall lighting or appearance qualification.

exportAssumptions.coordinates: Meters; Blender (x,y,z) -> glTF (x,z,-y) exactly once; positive rigid unit scale; identity template root.
exportAssumptions.images: Embedded PNG; source and decoded RGBA8 top-left pixel hashes must match.
exportAssumptions.animation: Rigid LINEAR tracks; every exported key and midpoint evaluated; duplicate end; no root motion.
exportAssumptions.implicitSettings: Record every effective glTF operator RNA default plus explicit overrides in technical.json; recipe hash binds that receipt.
exportAssumptions.hashes: profileSha256 is canonical profile ID, color and normalRendering; recipeSha256 binds this whole document, raw influencing inputs and effective settings, excluding generated technical/process/pending receipts. Every generated receipt is independently hash-bound in export inputs. Raw render_profile.json is also a hashed input.
